About the Team

Our US Marketplace team is responsible for growing the DoorDash business in the US, helping customers to discover & order what’s best in their city, merchants to grow their sales, and dashers to find flexible work.

About the Role

The US Marketplace team is looking for a motivated and hands-on Associate Manager to join the Strategy & Operations Growth and Markets team. You will own a portfolio of projects aimed at growing the core Marketplace business, working closely with DoorDash’s product, marketing, finance, and analytics teams.You’ll have the opportunity to help grow strategic markets, identify new growth bets, incubate 0-1 experiments, and execute on a roadmap to drive growth.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Build and own. You’ll have your fingerprints all over DoorDash’s next wave of growth. You’ll do whatever it takes to launch, get 1% better every day, and scale something completely new, from high-level strategy down to the nitty-gritty operational details.
• Incubate. You’ll take bets that don’t have an owner yet, scope them, test them, and either graduate them into funded programs or kill them with a clear, well-argued recommendation.
• Strategize. From first principles, you’ll develop the optimal strategy for growing segments and launching bets that no existing playbook covers.
• Experiment. You’ll turn strategies into operational experiments that create measurable, actionable outcomes, then use those results to shape the larger implementation plan.
• Analyze. You’ll pull your own data, assess the operational and financial impact of your decisions, and iterate based on what you find.
• Lead and collaborate. You’ll work with cross-functional partners across product, analytics, marketing, sales, and finance to get your initiatives resourced and shipped.

We’re excited about you because…

• You have 4+ years of experience in a problem-solving role: consulting, tech, banking, or similar. Experience taking something from 0 to 1 is strongly preferred.
• You’re highly analytical. You’re a data-driven problem solver who is comfortable running your own analysis in Excel or Google Sheets; SQL experience is strongly preferred.
• You’re comfortable in white space. You like being handed an undefined problem with no template, and you resist “this is how it’s always been done” thinking.
• You’re collaborative. You have experience partnering cross-functionally to drive results, and you can influence and motivate people you don’t manage.
• You’re able to think at the lowest level of detail while seeing the big picture. You get into the weeds, but you’re equally comfortable operating at 10,000 feet and thinking long-term.

You have a completed Bachelor’s Degree.

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

Amazon Fuse team is looking for a driven and talented Partner Growth Manager to support growth for Amazon's subscription services (Prime, Prime Video, Amazon Music, Kindle Unlimited, and more) through 3P partners in Southeast Asia and AU/NZ.

This is an execution-oriented, partner-facing, and data-driven growth role focused on driving customer acquisition, retention, and engagement through partner-led initiatives. The role involves managing day-to-day relationships with assigned partners, delivering measurable performance through integrated go-to-market (GTM) campaigns, data-led insights, and scalable marketing programs.

You will work closely with Business Development, Central Marketing and Partner Growth, Product, Lifecycle Management, and Finance teams to execute impactful campaigns that strengthen partner engagement and grow Amazon's customer base.

The ideal candidate is a motivated, detail-oriented marketer who thrives in fast-paced environments, can translate data into actionable insights, and is eager to develop expertise in strategic partnerships and growth marketing.

We're seeking a results-oriented, customer-obsessed professional with solid analytical skills, a bias for action, and enthusiasm for building high-impact marketing programs that drive measurable growth.

Key job responsibilities
• Own partner marketing plans and campaigns: Build and manage campaign plans for assigned partners, aligning objectives, audiences, channels, milestones, and deliverables. Coordinate execution from brief and readiness through launch, optimization, and post-campaign review..
• Deliver measurable growth: Develop and execute initiatives that improve offer awareness, adoption, customer engagement, and revenue across partner offers and customer segments. Monitor performance against goals, identify opportunities or risks, and adjust campaign tactics to improve outcomes..
• Lead go-to-market (GTM) execution: Bring Amazon service benefits to life through compelling partner marketing programs. Use Prime benefits, Prime Video content, seasonal moments such as Prime Day, and major launches to create timely, relevant campaigns across partner channels..
• Build strong partner relationships: Serve as a day-to-day marketing contact for assigned partners. Establish clear plans and expectations, share performance insights, resolve execution challenges, and build alignment around growth opportunities..
• Coordinate cross-functional delivery: Bring together Business Development, Finance, Technology, Product, and other stakeholders to deliver partner commitments. Clarify dependencies, surface risks early, and keep decisions and deliverables on track..
• Use data to guide decisions: Track campaign and offer performance, assess results across audiences and channels, and translate findings into clear recommendations. Share learnings with partners and internal teams to inform future plans and improve performance..
• Improve marketing operations: Identify opportunities to make campaign execution, reporting, and partner workflows more effective. Contribute to regional and global initiatives involving marketing automation, data quality, reporting, and process improvement..
• Communicate results and progress: Prepare clear, insight-led materials for quarterly business reviews (QBRs) and leadership updates. Summarize performance, explain key drivers, highlight risks, and recommend next steps..

Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate complex AI concepts into actionable insights for founders and engineering teams

Track record of selling technical products in competitive markets

Passion for making powerful technology safe and societally beneficial
